errors.text_span: Секторите са разположени във визуален ред по низходящ размер
errors.evidence: The description claims the sectors are arranged in descending order of size. However, the visual arrangement of the sectors, starting from the blue one and moving clockwise, is 22.1%, 42.6%, 23.5%, and 11.8%, which is not a descending order.
The description uses the word 'approximate' (приблизителен) for the value 42.6%, but this is the exact value written on the chart slice. This makes the phrasing slightly inaccurate.
